mapper.select: SELECT USER_ID AS userId , USER_NM AS userNm , USER_ENG_NM AS userEngNm , NULLIF(TRIM(GENDER_CD), '') AS genderCd , CASE WHEN BRTHDY IS NULL OR TRIM(CAST(BRTHDY AS CHAR)) = '' THEN NULL WHEN TRIM(CAST(BRTHDY AS CHAR)) REGEXP '^[0-9]{8}$' THEN TRIM(CAST(BRTHDY AS CHAR)) ELSE DATE_FORMAT(BRTHDY, '%Y%m%d') END AS brthdy , ZIP_CD AS zipCd , ADRES_ONE AS adresOne , ADRES_TWO AS adresTwo , CITY_NM AS cityNm , STATE_NM AS stateNm , NATION_CD AS nationCd , HOUSE_TELNO AS houseTelno , MBTLNUM AS mbtlnum , FXNUM AS fxnum , PASSWORD_HINT AS passwordHint , PASSWORD_CNSR AS passwordCnsr , EMAIL_ADRES AS emailAdres , USER_TYPE AS userType , SBSCRB_STTUS AS userSttusCd , CAST(FILE_SQ AS CHAR) AS profileFileSq FROM CM_USER WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}

SELECT BASE.EMPL_NO AS emplNo , BASE.OFCPS_NM_KEY AS ofcpsCd , BASE.OFFM_TELNO AS offmTelno , BASE.EMAIL_ADRES AS emailAdres , BASE.ECNY_YMD AS ecnyYmd , BASE.RETIRE_YMD AS retireYmd , BASE.DEPT_CD AS deptCd , C.MESSAGE_CN AS deptNm FROM ( SELECT A.EMPL_NO , A.OFCPS_NM_KEY , A.OFFM_TELNO , A.EMAIL_ADRES , A.ECNY_YMD , A.RETIRE_YMD , A.DEPT_CD , A.CMPNY_CD , B.DEPT_NM_KEY FROM CM_USER_ORGNZT_MBRSH A LEFT JOIN CM_DEPT B ON A.DEPT_CD = B.DEPT_CD AND A.CMPNY_CD = B.CMPNY_CD WHERE A.USER_ID = #{userId} AND A.CMPNY_CD = #{companyCode} AND A.USE_FL = 'Y' ) BASE LEFT JOIN CM_MESSAGE_LANG C ON C.LANG_KEY = BASE.DEPT_NM_KEY AND C.CMPNY_CD = BASE.CMPNY_CD AND C.LANG_CODE = #{languageCode}
SELECT DISTINCT A.CMPNY_CD FROM CM_USER_ORGNZT_MBRSH A WHERE A.USER_ID = #{userId} AND A.USE_FL = 'Y' ORDER BY A.CMPNY_CD

SELECT A.MBRSH_SQ AS mbrshSq , A.CMPNY_CD AS companyCode , COALESCE(CO.CMPNY_NM, A.CMPNY_CD) AS companyNm , A.EMPL_NO AS emplNo , A.OFCPS_NM_KEY AS ofcpsCd , A.OFFM_TELNO AS offmTelno , A.EMAIL_ADRES AS emailAdres , NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(A.ECNY_YMD AS CHAR)), '') AS ecnyYmd , NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(A.RETIRE_YMD AS CHAR)), '') AS retireYmd , A.DEPT_CD AS deptCd , D.MESSAGE_CN AS deptNm FROM CM_USER_ORGNZT_MBRSH A LEFT JOIN CM_CMPNY CO ON CO.CMPNY_CD = A.CMPNY_CD LEFT JOIN CM_DEPT B ON A.DEPT_CD = B.DEPT_CD AND A.CMPNY_CD = B.CMPNY_CD LEFT JOIN CM_MESSAGE_LANG D ON D.LANG_KEY = B.DEPT_NM_KEY AND D.CMPNY_CD = B.CMPNY_CD AND D.LANG_CODE = #{languageCode} WHERE A.USER_ID = #{userId} AND A.USE_FL = 'Y' ORDER BY A.CMPNY_CD
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM CM_USER_ORGNZT_MBRSH WHERE MBRSH_SQ = #{mbrshSq} AND USER_ID = #{userId} AND USE_FL = 'Y'

SELECT A.DEPT_CD AS deptCd , A.EMPL_NO AS emplNo , A.OFFM_TELNO AS offmTelno , A.EMAIL_ADRES AS emailAdres , A.OFCPS_NM_KEY AS ofcpsCd , NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(A.ECNY_YMD AS CHAR)), '') AS ecnyYmd , NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(A.RETIRE_YMD AS CHAR)), '') AS retireYmd FROM CM_USER_ORGNZT_MBRSH A WHERE A.MBRSH_SQ = #{mbrshSq} AND A.USER_ID = #{userId} AND A.USE_FL = 'Y'

SELECT A.DETAIL_CODE_ID AS langSectionCode , B.MESSAGE_CN AS langSectionName FROM CM_CODE_DETAIL A INNER JOIN CM_MESSAGE_LANG B ON B.LANG_KEY = A.CODE_LANG_KEY AND B.CMPNY_CD = A.CMPNY_CD WHERE A.CODE_ID = #{codeId} AND A.USE_FL = 'Y' AND A.CMPNY_CD = #{companyCode} AND B.LANG_CODE = #{languageCode} ORDER BY A.SORTING_SQ ASC
SELECT MBRSH_SQ FROM CM_USER_ORGNZT_MBRSH WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND CMPNY_CD = #{companyCode} AND USE_FL = 'Y'

SELECT BASE.CMPNY_CD AS cmpnyCd , BASE.DEPT_CD AS deptCd , BASE.DEPT_NM_KEY AS deptNmKey , B.MESSAGE_CN AS deptNm , BASE.UPPER_DEPT_CD AS upperDeptCd , BASE.UPPER_DEPT_NM_KEY AS upperDeptNmKey , UB.MESSAGE_CN AS upperDeptNm , BASE.DEPT_GRAD_CD AS deptGradCd , BASE.DPRLR_ID AS dprlrId , (SELECT M.USER_ID FROM CM_USER_ORGNZT_MBRSH M WHERE M.CMPNY_CD = BASE.CMPNY_CD AND M.MBRSH_SQ = BASE.DPRLR_ID LIMIT 1) AS dprlrUserId , (SELECT CASE WHEN #{languageCode} = 'en_US' THEN U.USER_ENG_NM ELSE U.USER_NM END FROM CM_USER_ORGNZT_MBRSH M INNER JOIN CM_USER U ON U.USER_ID = M.USER_ID WHERE M.MBRSH_SQ = BASE.DPRLR_ID) AS dprlrNm , BASE.EXPRTN_YMD AS exprtnYmd , BASE.USE_FL AS useFl , BASE.SORT_ORD AS sortOrd FROM ( SELECT C.CMPNY_CD , C.DEPT_CD , C.DEPT_NM_KEY , C.UPPER_DEPT_CD , UC.DEPT_NM_KEY AS UPPER_DEPT_NM_KEY , C.DEPT_GRAD_CD, C.DPRLR_ID , C.EXPRTN_YMD , C.USE_FL, C.SORT_ORD FROM CM_DEPT C LEFT JOIN CM_DEPT UC ON UC.CMPNY_CD = C.CMPNY_CD AND UC.DEPT_CD = C.UPPER_DEPT_CD WHERE C.CMPNY_CD = #{companyCode} AND C.DEPT_CD = #{deptCd} ) BASE LEFT JOIN CM_MESSAGE_LANG B ON B.LANG_KEY = BASE.DEPT_NM_KEY AND B.CMPNY_CD = BASE.CMPNY_CD AND B.LANG_CODE = #{languageCode} LEFT JOIN CM_MESSAGE_LANG UB ON UB.LANG_KEY = BASE.UPPER_DEPT_NM_KEY AND UB.CMPNY_CD = BASE.CMPNY_CD AND UB.LANG_CODE = #{languageCode}

SELECT A.MBRSH_SQ AS mbrshSq , A.USER_ID AS userId , CASE WHEN #{languageCode} = 'en_US' THEN B.USER_ENG_NM ELSE B.USER_NM END AS userNm , D.MESSAGE_CN AS deptNm FROM CM_USER_ORGNZT_MBRSH A INNER JOIN CM_USER B ON B.USER_ID = A.USER_ID LEFT JOIN CM_DEPT C ON A.DEPT_CD = C.DEPT_CD AND A.CMPNY_CD = C.CMPNY_CD LEFT JOIN CM_MESSAGE_LANG D ON D.LANG_KEY = C.DEPT_NM_KEY AND D.CMPNY_CD = C.CMPNY_CD AND D.LANG_CODE = #{languageCode} WHERE A.CMPNY_CD = #{companyCode} AND A.DEPT_CD = #{deptCd} AND A.USE_FL = 'Y'
AND (A.USER_ID LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%') OR B.USER_NM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%') OR B.USER_ENG_NM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY A.USER_ID
SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM CM_CMPNY WHERE CMPNY_CD = #{userId}) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM CM_USER WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}) THEN 'X' ELSE 'O' END
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CM_USER_ORGNZT_MBRSH (MBRSH_SQ, USER_ID, CMPNY_CD, DEPT_CD, EMPL_NO, OFFM_TELNO, EMAIL_ADRES, OFCPS_NM_KEY, ECNY_YMD, RETIRE_YMD, USE_FL, CREATION_ID, CREATION_DT) VALUES (#{mbrshSq}, #{userId}, #{companyCode}, #{deptCd}, #{emplNo}, #{offmTelno}, #{emailAdres}, #{ofcpsCd}, #{ecnyYmd}, #{retireYmd}, 'Y', #{creationId}, NOW())

INSERT INTO CM_DEPT (CMPNY_CD, DEPT_CD, DEPT_NM_KEY, UPPER_DEPT_CD, DEPT_GRAD_CD, DPRLR_ID, EXPRTN_YMD, USE_FL, SORT_ORD, CREATION_ID, CREATION_DT) VALUES (#{companyCode}, #{deptCd}, #{deptNmKey}, #{upperDeptCd}, #{deptGradCd}, #{dprlrId}, #{exprtnYmd}, #{useFl}, #{sortOrd}, #{creationId}, NOW())
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM CM_GROUP_USER WHERE CMPNY_CD = #{companyCode} AND MBRSH_SQ = #{mbrshSq}
